text:
Kuch baatein honthon tak aakar hi ruk gayi,
Tumne kabhi poocha nahi, humne kabhi bataya nahi.
Bas door se tumhe muskurate dekhna,
Isse zyada ishq ka koi aur silsila chaha hi nahi.
title: Ankahee Baatein
description: A soft and heartfelt reflection on silent love that remained unspoken between two people, capturing the beauty of distant admiration.
